transform: one transform shared by all compatible unit pairs of the documented series pair
provenance_evidence: Same research programme and author: W. L. Server co-authored both reports (ref 1: Server, Wullaert, Odette & Oldfield 1981, EPRI NP-1661; ref 21: Perrin, Fromm, Server & McConnell 1982), one year apart. Same material and specimen population: ref 1 series 6 is unirradiated HSST Plate 02 (SA533B-1), original plus reconstituted Charpy V-notch specimens [NP-1661] (D-031, D-032); ref 21 series 99 is unirradiated SA533B, original plus reconstituted specimens, from a report on preparing reconstituted Charpy V-notch specimens (title). Same structure (95 + 10 versus 104 + 12 specimens) and geometry (55x10x10 mm, 2 mm notch); no treatment recorded for either.
provenance_not_verified: Ref 21's full text was not checked; that its SA533B series is HSST Plate 02 is inferred from the evidence above and from the point pattern (outputs/wp1/duplicate_offset_evidence.csv), not read from ref 21.
